item.text:
I can’t guarantee the maximum-point schedule by inspection alone: this is a constrained scheduling optimization problem involving meeting windows, team availability, travel, and lunch breaks. I don’t have a solver or code execution available here, so I shouldn’t present a schedule as optimal without being able to verify it.

If you can provide a schedule optimizer’s output—or allow the problem to be solved with an external optimization tool—I can check the result and format the final CSV.
